objective: missing producer prerequisite: Stable text hash
reason: StableHash.Text accepts a non-null string value and exposes only an unsigned hash result; the current contract declares no error channel, so an owned rejection for an absent prerequisite is neither observable nor representable without changing the product API.
required_resolution: Rewrite the canonical case against a current observable StableHash contract before adding it to the executable manifest; do not treat a null dereference or process crash as the expected success oracle.
